items.title: A building complex sheltering tens of thousands of displaced people in Khan Yunis, in the Gaza Strip, catches fire after being hit by Israeli airstrikes, causing mass casualties. At least 214 civilians have been killed in the city in the past 24 hours by airstrikes.
Portugal reports a record 275 deaths in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide death toll to 10,469.
